RunSetup.title: Candidate Setup
RunSetup.subtitle: Choose your run parameters. Good luck with the interview.

poolMode.title: Question Pool Format
poolMode.description: Choose a preset direction or build the pool manually.

technologies.title: Technologies in Pool
technologies.description: Selected technologies can appear during the run.

briefing.title: Run Briefing
briefing.description: Build your pool and enter the interview.

items.setup: Choose Frontend preset or build Custom.
items.rooms: Choose doors, clear rooms, answer questions.
items.goal: Reach the final interview and survive.

startBonus.title: Start Gift
startBonus.description: You receive a random <gift>gift</gift> at the start of the run.

next.title: What Next?
next.description: After starting, you enter the first room, receive a <gift>gift</gift>, and choose a path.

pool.label: pool
pool.description: Question pool is the set of topics used for challenges.

stack.label: stack
stack.description: Stack is a preset set of technologies for the run.

gift.label: gift
gift.description: Gift is a positive effect that strengthens the candidate.

distortion.label: distortion
distortion.description: Distortion is a negative effect that makes the run harder.

run.label: run
run.description: A run is one attempt to clear rooms and reach the final interview.

pause.title: PAUSED
pause.savePolicy: Progress is saved after each room. The current question sequence will restart.

exit.title: EXIT RUN?
exit.description: The current room is not complete. You will return to the latest saved checkpoint.
exit.warning: Completed rooms and collected effects are saved. Answers from the current room will be reset.

restart.title: RESTART RUN?
restart.description: A new run will replace the current progress, selected technologies, and all collected effects.
restart.warning: This action cannot be undone. The current run will end without a result and disappear from continue.

buffDescriptions.noiseSuppression: Automatically removes one incorrect option from every question.
buffDescriptions.stackNavigator: Reveals the next room's technology icon on one random door in every room.
buffDescriptions.headStart: Every room starts with one answer already counted as correct.
buffDescriptions.deepSpecialization: Entering a room with the same technology as the previous room grants one additional counted correct answer.
buffDescriptions.broadProfile: When the new room uses a different technology, two incorrect options are blocked in the first question.
buffDescriptions.refactoring: After every three perfectly completed rooms, one active debuff is removed automatically and the counter resets.
buffDescriptions.stableResult: A normally completed room grants a buff as if it had been completed perfectly.
buffDescriptions.debuffImmunity: The player can no longer receive new debuffs.

debuffDescriptions.routeSubstitution: The selected door has a 50% chance to be replaced by another one.
debuffDescriptions.lostTranslation: One answer option is translated into Chinese.
debuffDescriptions.glassCeiling: Impression cannot be raised to strong.
debuffDescriptions.technicalDebt: Non-perfect rooms gradually add questions to subsequent challenges.
debuffDescriptions.undeclaredStack: A question from a technology outside the selected pool is added to the challenge.
debuffDescriptions.busFactor: An error in the selected dangerous technology counts as two.
debuffDescriptions.reversedWording: The words in one question are displayed in reverse order.
debuffDescriptions.crossFunctionalTeam: Every challenge receives one additional random question from any topic.
debuffDescriptions.buffBan: The player can no longer receive new buffs.
debuffDescriptions.failedStart: The first question in every room cannot be answered correctly.
